tasks.title: Create Beads 0.56.1 spike tracking artifacts
tasks.goal: Create spec/plan/tasks artifacts and a dependency-backed BD execution graph for the upgrade spike.
acceptance_criteria: Spec and plan documents define scope, risks, acceptance criteria, and rollout/rollback.
BD epic + dependent child tasks exist and pass bd lint.

tasks.title: Add doctor checks for Beads version and Dolt readiness
tasks.goal: Extend doctor checks to explicitly validate Beads 0.56.1 baseline and bd dolt readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor reports bd-version with minimum target >=0.56.1.
Doctor reports bd-dolt readiness from bd dolt show output.
Unit tests cover version and dolt-show parsing behavior.

tasks.title: Wire harness preflight to Beads 0.56.1 readiness behavior
tasks.goal: Ensure harness preflight strict mode enforces new doctor Beads checks and update shell preflight messaging.
acceptance_criteria: Strict preflight treats bd-version and bd-dolt warnings as actionable failures.
Preflight script references target Beads version and delegates to harness preflight strict.

tasks.title: Update docs for Beads 0.56.1 semantics
tasks.goal: Align docs and runbooks with Beads 0.56.1 behavior and remove stale bd sync assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: No updated docs claim bd sync commits/pushes to beads-sync.
Runbook provides explicit Beads 0.56.1 install, Dolt readiness, and validation flow.

tasks.title: Run gates and close spike with evidence
tasks.goal: Run verification gates, capture evidence in plan doc, and close BD tasks.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./... and go vet ./... pass.
Doctor and harness preflight strict evidence captured.
BD tasks are closed and bd sync is executed.
